rationale.consistency: Integrates cleanly with existing code by replacing the reverse workaround with a dedicated parallel function.
rationale.edge_cases: Fails catastrophically on non-ASCII paths because strings.EqualFold returns true for any pair of invalid single UTF-8 bytes (>= 0x80).
rationale.scope: Applies case-insensitivity to the entire suffix comparison, not just the hex digits of an escape as required.
rationale.readability: The right-to-left parsing logic is well-commented and its intent is easy to follow despite the underlying bugs.
rationale.robustness: Silent data corruption occurs because differing non-ASCII suffixes will erroneously match and be stripped from the path.
rationale.maintainability: Byte-by-byte string extraction coupled with rune-aware comparison functions creates a brittle and dangerous pattern.
